subject: SOC 2: targeted auth evidence request - MFA rotation & privileged access review
messages:
From: Natalie Rios <natalie.rios@healthnova.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@healthnova.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:15:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — SOC 2 slices (MFA rotation + privileged access)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the SOC 2 Type II you previously shared. The audit team for HealthNova is doing a focused verification relating to authentication and privileged access controls. They asked whether Redwood can provide the following supplemental artifacts scoped to your most recent SOC 2 period: 

- MFA enforcement configuration and a sample of MFA rotation/validation logs for the last 90 days (primary requirement: proof that MFA is enforced for all interactive accounts and that rotation/verification events are logged).
- Privileged access review report (listing accounts with admin/privileged roles) and evidence that periodic reviews were completed during the SOC 2 period (meeting notes, attestation).
- A brief bridge note describing any control changes since the report date that could affect these controls.

Can you confirm whether you can produce CSV/CSV-export slices of auth events and a PDF of the privileged-access attestation? If you have a template manifest of artifacts, please share so our audit log ingestion team can plan. We have a compressed delivery window — auditors would like these by EOD 2027-05-25 if possible.

Best,
Natalie
Security Programs Manager
HealthNova

----
Attachment: (none)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Rios <natalie.rios@healthnova.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SOC 2 slices (MFA rotation + privileged access)

Hi Natalie — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We can provide targeted artifacts; below is what we propose and a few clarifying questions so our delivery meets the auditors' expectations.

Plan (high level):
- Deliverables: redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf (already provided), auth_log_slice_may2027.csv (90-day slice), priv_access_review_202704.pdf (latest review), prelim_evidence_manifest.csv (artifact index).
- Delivery method: shared Drive folder + GPG-signed manifest.
- ETA: initial package by COB 2027-05-24; final delivery by 2027-05-25 if no additional scope asked.

Clarifications needed:
1) For the MFA slice, do you need raw auth events (every sign-in and MFA step) or a filtered extract (MFA enforcement failures + successful MFA confirmations)? We can provide either; raw is larger but fully auditable.
2) For privileged access, do you want a history of role changes for each privileged account during the SOC 2 period or a snapshot plus sign-off evidence for periodic review?
3) Are there any PII redaction requirements on the event export we should apply before sharing?

I'll loop Neha (security/compliance) and Ben (Customer Success / delivery) on schedule and packaging.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Liang <tom.liang@3rdparty-audit.com>

Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — SOC 2 slices (MFA rotation + privileged access)

Hi Soojin and Natalie,

Quick note from the audit side: raw sign-in + MFA step events for the 90-day window are ideal (we ingest CSVs). Please include event timestamps, user id (pseudonymized if necessary), event type (sign_in, mfa_challenge, mfa_success, mfa_fail), auth_method (email_totp, webrtc_webauthn, etc.), and source IP. For privileged access, we need the role change history (grants/revocations) tied to an attestation (who signed off and when). If you can provide a small sample file in the same schema by EOD 2027-05-23, we can confirm ingestion schema and avoid rework.

Regards,
Tom Liang
Senior Auditor
ThirdParty Audit LLP

Team — quick update and delivery plan. See attached sample CSV (auth_log_slice_may2027.csv) and the privilege attestation PDF (priv_access_review_202704.pdf). Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqE-redwood-evidence-share (drive access granted to healthnova-security@redwood.ai and tom.liang@3rdparty-audit.com).

Notes on artifacts provided:
- MFA events: we included full sign_in and MFA lifecycle events for the last 90 days. User identifiers are hashed (sha256) per our data sharing agreement; the audit team confirmed hashed ids are acceptable as long as the hashing approach is documented (included in manifest).
- Role history: CSV contains grant/revoke events for privileged roles; priv_access_review_202704.pdf contains the review attestation signed by our Security Director for April 2027.
- Bridge note: brief stmt in the manifest clarifies there were no control changes affecting MFA or privileged access during the SOC 2 period; if anything changed post-report it is captured in the manifest with timestamps.

Next steps: If Tom can confirm the sample schema is ingestible, we'll proceed with full package delivery by EOD 2027-05-24.

Thanks,
Soojin
